question: In the bicompatimental pharmacokinetic model, after intravenous administration in bolus, different volumes of distribution can be calculated: central compartment volume (V1), total volume in steady state (Vdss), extrapolated volume (Vdextr) and area volume (Vdarea). The calculation of Vdss is made from:

options.opa: The drug-transfer rates between the central and peripheral compartments when the amount in the peripheral is maximum.
options.opb: The amount of drug in the terminal phase.
options.opc: Relationship between the administered dose and the maximum concentration in the central compartment.
options.opd: Relationship between the dose administered and the maximum concentration in the peripheral compartment.
